 Follow Netflix Thriller Series Is Officially the No. 1 Show in the World One Week After New Season Drops
 Matthew Thomas Fri, November 13, 2026 at 3:59 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. On November 5, 2026, Black Doves Season 2 premiered on Netflix with six new episodes of the hit spy thriller. Now, the series starring Keira Knightley, Ben Whishaw, and Sarah Lancashire is the top show in the world on Netflix one week later.
 'Black Doves' Is Officially the No. 1 Show in the World on Netflix
 A scene from Black Doves showing Ben Whishaw and Keira Knightley standing side by side.Courtesy of Matthew Towers/Netflix © 2026
 The website FlixPatrol chronicles the top series and movies on streaming by publishing daily lists of the most-viewed content on all of the popular services. After it previously rose to No. 2 , Black Doves is now the No. 1 TV show on Netflix globally as of November 13, 2026 . Notably, it also has a substantial lead over the next most-watched series, Taken: Natalee Holloway . The British spy thriller first topped the chart two days ago, on November 11, 2026 , before widening the gap the following day to hold the No. 1 spot exactly one week after its Season 2 release.
 What Is 'Black Doves'?
 Black Doves is a Netflix Original British spy action thriller created by Joe Barton, which stars Keira Knightley, Ben Whishaw, and Sarah Lancashire. In the series, Knightley portrays an undercover spy who leads a double life as a dedicated mother and wife. She appears alongside Whishaw, who embodies an assassin who comes out of hiding to help protect her after she is targeted.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In 2025, Knightley was nominated for Best Performance by a Female Actor in a Television Series – Drama at the Golden Globe Awards for her acting in Black Doves . An acclaimed series, Black Doves currently holds a 94% Rotten Tomatoes score, with its second season earning a higher 96% rating. One recent Pajiba review featured a headline that summarizes much of the critical reception of the series: "The Most Enjoyable Binge in Ages."
 Why 'Black Doves' Is Likely the No. 1 Show in the World Right Now
 When a series becomes the No. 1 show on Netflix worldwide, it is often the most-watched series in the world. According to Nielsen data, the No. 1 non-sports show in the U.S. for the week ending November 8, 2026, was ABC World News Tonight, which garnered just over 9.5 million viewers in America. However, the most-viewed series on Netflix for the same week, Taken: Natalee Holloway , drew 12.9 million views worldwide .
 In addition to surpassing network TV's top non-sports programming, Netflix's immense global popularity often gives its top series far greater reach than any of its streaming rivals. According to FlixPatrol , Netflix currently has roughly 325 million subscribers worldwide, while its closest runner-up, Prime Video, has 200 million. In fact, Netflix has more global subscribers than Disney+, Paramount+, Peacock, Apple TV, and Crunchyroll combined.
 Given those numbers, it is very likely that Black Doves is currently the No. 1 show in the world, or at least very close to the top.
